name: enable-banking-mcp
description: Personal MCP server for bank data via Enable Banking PSD2 AIS API

AUTH_SECRET.description: A password you choose. Used to log in to the setup page, approve Claude/ChatGPT connections, and as the bearer token for Cursor. Use a long random value and save it in your password manager.

BANKING_KV.description: Stores your bank connection and encrypted Enable Banking key. Keep the default name.

OAUTH_KV.description: Stores logins from Claude/ChatGPT. Keep the default name.
